title: Ulyana and the Terminal
author: Ulyana Coldharbour
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
